change_summary: Preserve bounded owner discovery, one semantic Question, and the complete Resource Front while making exact continuation handles directly executable and moving official Plugin freshness into transport-owned metadata.

canonical_skill.note: The canonical Skill keeps Work Model semantics in the existing one-effect owner path, prefers Host-native source carriers, copies exact typed continuation handles into executable reads, and distinguishes Plugin transport freshness from standalone model-reported fallback.

server_contract.note: The server advertises release 1.7.87 and contract 2026-09-28.2 with the same one-Question, complete-owner-receipt, typed-source and Resource Front boundaries; it accepts exact typed continuation handles, consumes public Plugin freshness headers without treating them as installation proof, preserves exact inline UTF-8 text, and rejects caller digest mismatch before creating a Question.

package_manifests.note: Skill and Plugin versions advance together for durable learning, host clarification, cross-host semantic materialization, typed continuation reads, and package-declared MCP freshness metadata.

workspace_cli.note: The CLI preserves exact selected Markdown and computes its SHA-256 outside the model-visible body, while keeping owner discovery on read tools and carrying constrained-owner handles into one allow-actions effect without an answer-only preview.

help_center.note: The existing public Help remains compatible; file-carrier digest and package activation are developer-host contracts rather than a new end-user workflow.

package_setup.note: The compact SessionStart hook reports release 1.7.87 and contract 2026-09-28.2, names the canonical Skill, relies on Plugin MCP transport for package freshness, and leaves the preserved owner-read, one-Question and cross-host routing boundaries to the Skill and live tools.

harness_and_mainline.note: The mainline records the historical activation and typed-carrier chain, makes exact continuation executable, separates transport registration from installed Skill evidence, and keeps arbitrary chat-native binding as an explicit remaining Host boundary.

external_marketplaces.note: Publishing release 1.7.87 and deployed marketplace discovery remain separate release-owned gates; isolated local Codex Plugin acceptance does not prove deployment.

public_release_assets.note: The canonical exporter regenerates both immutable archives from synchronized 1.7.87 Skill, references, manifests, MCP metadata, compact hook source, and explicit Codex manifest.

release_evidence.note: Schema, MCP/CLI/Skill parity, Resource Front composition, exact-effect grading and linked Host recall cover the shared route. Backend and CLI tests add exact bytes, typed locator and kind validation, transport freshness precedence, digest mismatch rejection and async rehydration; export/install/header checks and fresh Plugin cases keep business outcomes, economics, activation, Skill reads, context recall and lifecycle as separate evidence.
